page.notes: Lower part of the page is blank apart from stains and specks. The first line of the scan begins mid-sentence ("magis, quàm"), so the text is a fragment carried over from the previous page. Some words at the line ends are hard to read because of the scan; "associauit" and "Germanicam" are read with some doubt. The mark "AD" at the foot is a gathering signature, not text.
